messages:
Nadia Feldman: Heads-up: starting all-hands in 5. AV reported intermittent segment drops on the primary recorder in us-west. Anyone on standby for fallback?
Priya Rao: I'm here. Ethan, can you confirm if the recording ingest is failing or just buffering?
Ethan Park: Dashboard shows brief SRT reconnects and small packet loss spikes. Not full failure yet but risky.
ops-bot: Notice: recorder-us-west elevated error rate (5xx) detected. Event REC-WS-2156.
Noah Li: Quick mitigation: enable local OBS capture on podium laptop and mirror via SRT to our internal staging (10.7.6.5:9000). That bypasses the CDN. I can flip the mixer.
Sasha Kim: I'll prep hosts: call out any caption delay and pause ~3s after slide changes. Also added a one-slide note about Q3 infra timeline to clarify roadmap changes.
Nadia Feldman: Good. Ethan, please coordinate the mixer switch and post the temporary playback link once live. Priya, will you mention the infra ETA in roadmap?
Priya Rao: Yes 
TL;DR in talk: infra tweaks push Dedicated launch by ~2-3 weeks but Hosted SLA unaffected.
Ethan Park: Switching mixer to staging ingest now. Command run: /api/v1/mixer/switch --from=cdn-usw --to=staging-10-7-6-5 --id=rec-2156
ops-bot: Action: mixer route changed by Ethan Park at 2156789054.
Noah Li: OBS live and recording local. Uploaded a 12s test to staging: https://files.internal/tmp/obs-test-2156.mp4
Sasha Kim: Hosts briefed. I'll announce caption offset during transitions.
Nadia Feldman: Monitor recorder and captions for the first 10 mins. Tag me if websocket drops or 5xx resumes. We'll capture logs and follow up with an incident write-up and a runbook update.
Ethan Park: Recorder logs look stable for 120s. Caption websocket shows 1 reconnect but holding.
Priya Rao: Perfect. During Q&A I'll ask for any product questions about the timeline and collect action items in the shared doc: https://docs.internal/allhands/q-and-a-2156
Nadia Feldman: Thanks team. Post-call we'll add a fallback section to the all-hands runbook with exact mixer commands and contact rotations. :thumbsup:
